title: VooPoo PnP X Replacement Pods (DTL) - 2 Pack
description: The Voopoo PnP X Cartridge DTL is expertly designed for Direct-To-Lung vapers who use the Voopoo PnP X Pod Kit. These replacement pods are engineered to offer an enhanced DTL experience, focusing on rich flavour and significant cloud production. Conveniently sold in packs of two, they ensure that you’re always equipped with a fresh pod. Each pod in the pack has a 2ml e-liquid capacity, providing ample space for your favourite DTL e-liquids. The pods are specifically tailored for use with the Voopoo PnP X Pod Kit, ensuring a secure magnetic connection and optimal performance with every use. These DTL pods are compatible with PnP X Coils, allowing you to choose your preferred coil resistance based on your vaping style and e-liquid preference. This versatility makes the PnP X Cartridge DTL an excellent choice for vapers who enjoy a robust and flavourful Direct-To-Lung vaping experience. Whether at home or on the go, the Voopoo PnP X Cartridge DTL pods offer an effortless and enjoyable way to enjoy your DTL vaping sessions. Their straightforward design ensures hassle-free pod replacement, guaranteeing a clean and efficient vaping experience every time. Please note: These pods are ONLY compatible with Voopoo Drag S2 pod vape kit and Voopoo Drag X2 pod vape kit
